Can target actuals, sensitive transcript content, or model-era drift contaminate a forecast?

findings.summary: Retained AC-7 baseline boundary was inconsistent with acceptance truth.
PR branch did not incorporate current-main split-authority changes.
GitHub adapter rejected qualified cross-repository closing linkage and did not verify publication authority.
Session adapter could not emit schema drift for unsupported availability or schema versions.
Cycle-time comparison added overlapping intervals instead of wall-clock elapsed time.
Retained validation summary was stale at generation 49 and omitted its claimed format lane.

residual_risk: No equivalent terminal candidate cohort exists; WP-05 intentionally makes no cycle-time or reconnection reduction claim.
